title: Early Planet Formation in Embedded Disks (eDisk): XVI. Asymmetric dust disk driving a multicomponent molecular outflow in the young Class 0 protostar GSS30 IRS3
question: What are the dust disk structure, rotation/stellar mass, and outflow components of the Class 0 protostar GSS30 IRS3 at ~8 au resolution?

evidence.quote: located at a distance of $\sim$138.4 $\pm$ 2.6 pc (cite: Ortiz-Leon18) based on the recent Gaia measurements.
with a bolometric luminosity ($L\mathrm{_{bol}}$) of 1.7 L$_{\odot}$, and the bolometric temperature is 50 K (cite: eDisk)
$\kappa_{\nu}$(2.3 cm$^{2}$ g$^{-1}$) is the absorption coefficient adopted from (cite: Beckwith+1990)
$\phi$ corresponds to the assumed flaring angle of 0.02 radian (cite: Huang2018)

recipe.goal: Measure continuum disk size, flux, inclination
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit (imfit) and 5σ contour measurement; inclination from cos i = b/a
Optically thin isothermal M = S D^2/(κ B(Td))
key_parameters: Td = 20 K and 49 K (T=43(L/Lsun)^0.25); κ=2.3 cm2/g; D=138 pc

recipe.method: Frank visibility-space 1D radial profile fit, fixed i=64.3 deg, PA=109 deg, alpha=1.30, wsmooth=1e-4; Gaussians fit to bumps; compare Tb with midplane temperature
assumptions: Passively heated flared disk, flaring angle 0.02 rad, L=1.7 Lsun

recipe.method: PV diagram along PA 109 deg (0.17 arcsec width) and SLAM edge/ridge single and double power-law MCMC fits; mass averaged over ridge and edge
key_parameters: Systemic velocity 2.84 km/s fixed after first fit

recipe.method: 12CO Tex from peak Tb, optical depth in wings, column density, mass with CO abundance 1e-4; formulas of Santamaria-Miranda 2020 with inclination correction
assumptions: Optically thin wings; outflow perpendicular to disk

evidence.quote: the peak intensity and the flux density obtained by this method are 6.38 mJy beam$^{-1}$ and 133.7 mJy, respectively
provides values of 75.1 $\pm$ 2.9 M$_{\Earth}$ and 25.80 $\pm$ 0.99 M$_{\Earth}$
provides values of 75.1 $\pm$ 2.9 M$_{\Earth}$ and 25.80 $\pm$ 0.99 M$_{\Earth}$
The bumps are located at a radius of $\sim$0$.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$19 ($\sim$26 au) and the other located at $\sim$0$.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$36 ($\sim$50 au)

answer_key.value: 18.9 K and 9.6 K (vs 27.8 K and 20.2 K midplane)

evidence.quote: the observed brightness temperature at 0$.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$19 and 0$.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$36 are 18.9 K and 9.6 K, respectively
Therefore, we adopt a mass of GSS30 IRS3 is 0.35$\pm$0.09 M$_{\odot}$.
The systemic velocity is 2.84 km s$^{-1}$
The total outflow mass of the molecular outflow is 6.1$\times10^{-5}$ M$_{\odot}$

score_reason: Data identified and many key parameters given, but heavy reliance on eDisk overview paper for reduction.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results (flux, inclination, dust mass, SLAM mass) with fairly complete recipe.
